name: unifi-innerspace
description: UniFi InnerSpace MCP server — read floor plans, placed devices and walls, and edit a plan's layout with previews

host.title: Host
host.description: UniFi console IP address or hostname that runs InnerSpace

username.title: Username
username.description: Local console account for the login session. InnerSpace never uses an API key

password_file.title: Password file
password_file.description: Absolute path to a file that holds the password. Set one password source only

password_command.title: Password command
password_command.description: Absolute argv, run without a shell, that prints the password. Set one password source only

password.title: Password
password.description: Password stored in the system keychain. Prefer a password file or command. Set one password source only

verify_ssl.title: Verify SSL
verify_ssl.description: Verify the TLS certificate. Without verification or a fingerprint, anyone on the network path can read the password

ssl_fingerprint.title: Certificate fingerprint
ssl_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the console's certificate on the HTTPS port, as openssl prints it. When set, only that certificate is accepted, whatever Verify SSL says

policy_create.title: Allow create
policy_create.description: Allow tools that create walls, wall types, attenuation objects and their types. Off keeps them disabled

policy_update.title: Allow update
policy_update.description: Allow tools that change walls, attenuation objects, their types, floor plan settings and the project unit. Off keeps them disabled

policy_delete.title: Allow delete
policy_delete.description: Allow tools that remove walls and attenuation objects or replace a plan's scale. Off keeps them disabled

permission_mode.title: Permission mode
permission_mode.description: confirm previews every mutation before it runs; bypass runs it immediately

registration_mode.title: Tool registration
registration_mode.description: lazy loads tools on demand; eager registers every tool; meta_only exposes only discovery tools
